ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large high-intensity (white) regions occupy the distal sections of both lobes, separated by a dominant low-intensity (black) central corridor. Significant low-intensity mottling and a distinctive dark circular annulus are located within the white region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a vertex angle approximately 50 degrees; notch depth is clearly defined against the foam-filled background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing edge with visible peaks and valleys (amplitude 5-15 pixels) most prominent on the right lobe's medial-to-distal section.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge trajectory exhibits a concave curve originating from the median notch, transitioning to a convex upward sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of high-intensity, bulbous 3D-textured pixels localized at the extreme distal tips and in smaller clusters along the trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple parallel low-intensity linear marks (rake patterns) traversing the high-intensity fields vertically on the left lobe and diagonally on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular texture and white pixel clusters on the distal tips (barnacle colonization); one distinct dark circular ring-like mark on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive dark circular annulus (ring-shaped mark) located on the distal white field of the right lobe lobe.
